title: OL-20261115-5: PUBLIC-RELEASE: flip repositories public (counsel gate dropped)
body:
**Owner:** the fleet
**Trigger:** repository visibility is public
**Done check:** grep:github/org-settings.json::"visibility": "public" ; gh api repos/ultrastable/<repo> shows private=false for workers, spec, license, seed, ops, ultrastable
**Status:** open

Superseded gate: owner decision 2026-11-15 drops the counsel review; the license is the protection and the repositories are public. All wording was removed in PRs ultrastable#394 and workers. Remaining step is the visibility setting itself, which the session proxy refuses (repository settings writes); it is the only open part and carries the default in effect: repositories stay private until flipped. ultrastable additionally needs its git history cleaned of the removed qnfo-platform-thread archive first.
